messages:
sophia: quick post-RFC follow-up — proposing we simplify endpoint backing by migrating from per-tenant sidecars to a consolidated regional relay pool. outline below, PTAL.

eli: tl;dr: reduce ENI + sidecar surface area. key constraint is preserving source IP semantics for customers who rely on it. need concrete ip-preservation tests.

matt: +1 on simplification. main ops risk: cert rotation + handshake timing during cutover. we need a staging runbook and automated rollback.

chen: product note: enterprise customers sometimes require static egress IPs and whitelistable addresses. migration must provide an IP-preservation shim or opt-in exemption window.

sophia: proposed phases: 1) passive telemetry & request mirroring from sidecars to relay (no path change); 2) opt-in relay routing for small tenant set; 3) bulk migrate with epoched DNS / routing cutover + IP-preservation shim; 4) retire sidecars. each phase has validation gates.

eli: tests to add: simple health request through relay: `curl -v -H "Host: customer.example" https://relay.us-west-2.redwood.internal/health` -> expect 200 and header `X-Backed-By: relay`. also test source-ip header preserved.

matt: canary success criteria (suggestion): 99th-percentile latency increase <5ms, absolute error-rate delta <0.1%, TLS handshake failures = 0. rollback if sustained 2x 5xx or >5 customer-reported failures in 30m.

sophia: ops runbook snippet: 
```
# trigger canary for tenant t-123
rbctl relay assign --tenant-id t-123 --region us-west-2 --mode canary
# validation logs
kubectl logs -l tenant=t-123 -n ingress | grep "relay-backend:ok"
```

eli: fallback policy: if relay cannot reach tenant endpoint, fallback to sidecar for 5 minutes and fire an incident. prefer circuit-breaker over immediate failover to avoid thrash.

matt: observability must include spans `relay.proxy_forward` and a metric `relay.request_source_preserved` (0/1). alert if preserved < 99.5% over 15m or if relay.latency_p99 > baseline + 5ms.

chen: compliance: for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) we should keep sidecars by default; relay only for hosted accounts or by explicit customer consent. update sales/PS with migration implications.

sophia: schedule proposal: start passive mirroring next week (low risk) -> then 2-week opt-in window -> phased bulk cutover by region. I'll author the detailed playbook.

eli: edge-case: customers using client IP for rate-limiting or geo-blocking will break unless we preserve IP or add a token handshake. recommend migration notes and automated header-mgmt.

matt: runbook check to verify IP preservation: 
```
# verify X-Forwarded-For preserved
curl -s https://api.redwood/internal/test-ip | jq '.source_ip'
```

sophia: any objections to me opening the RFC follow-up PR with the migration checklist + rollout automation tasks?

chen: no objections, +1.

deploy-bot: mirror-config v2026.03.21-rc1 deployed to staging :rocket:

matt: I'll own rollback automation and alerts tuning.

eli: I'll add e2e tests to the integ suite and the new metrics.

sophia: thanks all — i'll open the PR and tag infra/sre/networking for review.
